# Wendy Plesniak's icons for Slicer (SimpleColorStyle)

- **By:** Wendy Plesniak.
- **From:** github.com/Slicer/slicer-media-assets, `SlicerIcons/SlicerSVG/SimpleColorStyle/{DarkThemeIcons,LightThemeIcons}`, commit
  `bf416c0aaace126fb535f24822202de9a4c53d0e` (her last change, 2025-01-24). 802 SVG files, unchanged; her README beside them; plus
  the four files she sent on 2026-11-08 (below).
- **License:** the 3D Slicer License (`License-3D-Slicer.txt`, from github.com/Slicer/Slicer, `License.txt`). The repository is the
  Slicer organization's and carries no license of its own; the Slicer license covers "contributions to and downloads from" Slicer,
  "software and/or data" (lines 13-16). Ron Kikinis, 2026-11-08: "that means slicer license, unless spelled otherwise."
- **Her word:** asked by Ron on 2026-11-07 (use in Albula, credit by name, changes sent back to her); her answer, 2026-11-08: "Nothing
  would make me happier than you using these icons for whatever wonderful work you and Steve are developing."
- **The credit, in her words** (her longer note, 2026-11-08, "Modify as you need to"; used unchanged in the application's
  Help & Acknowledgment and beside Settings › Icons): "Icons designed by Wendy Plesniak in collaboration with the 3D Slicer developer
  team. Style is based on and incorporates some of Google's Material Symbols (Apache License Version 2.0)." The Apache License's text:
  `License-Apache-2.0.txt`. If the wording in Albula changes, tell her (she asked to hear back if she should state it differently).
- **Added from her note** (2026-11-08, "add them to your checkout at this path for completeness"), as she sent them: her two updated
  viewers, `DarkThemeIcons/DarkThemeIconsIndex.html` and `LightThemeIcons/LightThemeIconsIndex.html` (they add the Material Symbols
  paragraph above the guidelines; open one in a browser to see the whole set), and `LightThemeIcons/SlicerCommonSymbols/SlicerDatabase.svg`
  and `SlicerDataBundle.svg`, the light versions missing there. So this copy is no longer identical to `bf416c0` in those four files.
- **Our additions are not in this folder:** two pictures derived from her `DataIO/DICOMIO.svg` (the cylinder with one arrow, out or in)
  live in Albula's own icon module, `render/demos/icon-set.ts`, and go back to her.
